scenario.name: SaaS B2B Contract Negotiation
scenario.description: Annual recurring revenue contract negotiation for enterprise software

objectives.batna: Walk away and pursue competitor deal worth 30K EUR

concession_budget: Can reduce implementation time by 2 weeks

objectives.target: 30K EUR ARR with flexibility to cancel

tactics: Will use false urgency (competing vendor deadline)

timeline.ai_suggestion: Ignore anchor, focus on value proposition
timeline.optimal_response: Let me explain the ROI you'll achieve...

timeline.event: False urgency: 'Competing vendor needs decision by Friday'
timeline.ai_suggestion: Call bluff professionally, maintain timeline control
timeline.optimal_response: I understand timing is important. Let's ensure you make the right decision for your needs.

timeline.event: Price objection: 'Too expensive for our budget'
timeline.ai_suggestion: Focus on total cost of ownership and ROI
timeline.optimal_response: Let's look at the value over 3 years and time savings...
Let me propose something different: what if we include premium training?
It sounds like you see value. What would help you feel confident moving forward?

timeline.event: Negotiation settling at 42K EUR ARR, 2-year term
timeline.optimal_response: Great! Let's finalize the details. When can we schedule implementation?

timeline.event: Nibbling attempt: 'Oh, can we also get the mobile app included?'
timeline.ai_suggestion: Reopen entire negotiation if adding terms
timeline.optimal_response: If we're modifying the agreement, I'd like to revisit the pricing structure as well.

timeline.event: Final agreement: 45K EUR ARR, 2-year, mobile app included, 60-day terms

manipulation_detection: C'est une offre qui expire aujourd'hui
Tous nos autres clients acceptent ces conditions
Mon patron ne va jamais accepter ça
Au fait, j'ai oublié de mentionner...
opportunity_detection: On a un budget prévu pour ça
C'est vraiment un problème pour nous
objection_patterns: Je dois en parler à mon manager
On n'a pas le budget cette année
